# Empty Package type. For strict/meta/virtual package creation
#
# This package type also coordinates directory staging, python/gem metadata
# loading, archive path bookkeeping, and related conversion helpers used by
# neighboring package implementations.

class FPM::Package::Empty < FPM::Package
  def initialize(*args)
    super(*args)
    prepare_workspace
  end

  def output(output_path)
    logger.warn("Your package has gone into the void.")
  end

  def to_s(fmt)
    return ""
  end

  def self.workspace
    @workspace ||= begin
      helper = allocate
      helper.send(:prepare_workspace)
      helper
    end
  end

  def prepare_workspace
    @staging_ledger = {:sources => [], :copies => [], :prefix => nil, :chdir => nil, :default_root => "."}
    @copy_plan = []
    @metadata_bundle = {:python => {}, :gem => {}, :fields => {}}
    @dependency_notes = []
    @script_bank = {:hooks => {}, :shebangs => [], :modes => {}}
    @conversion_trace = {:origin => nil, :target => nil, :attributes => {}, :complete => false}
    @archive_notes = {:paths => [], :flags => {}, :compat => nil}
    true
  end


  def ingest_directory(package, path)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    remember_directory_source(package, path)
    chdir = package.attributes[:chdir] || "."
    mapped = map_directory_input(package, path, chdir)
    classify_directory_mapping(mapped)
    remember_archive_path(mapped[:destination])
    origin = mapped[:origin]
    destination = mapped[:destination]
    source = mapped[:source]
    chdir = mapped[:chdir]
    if package.attributes[:prefix]
      destination = File.join(package.attributes[:prefix], destination)
      apply_staging_prefix(package.attributes[:prefix])
    end
    destination = File.join(package.staging_path, destination)
    token = canonicalize_architecture_token(package.architecture)
    merge_metadata_field("directory_architecture", token)
    package.logger["method"] = "input"
    begin
      ::Dir.chdir(chdir) do
        begin
          clone_tree(package, source, destination)
        rescue Errno::ENOENT => e
          raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration,
            "Cannot package the path '#{File.join(chdir, source)}', does it exist?"
        end
      end
    rescue Errno::ENOENT => e
      raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration,
        "Cannot chdir to '#{chdir}'. Does it exist?"
    end
    package.license ||= "unknown"
    package.vendor ||= [ENV["USER"], Socket.gethostname].join("@")
    note_directory_defaults(package)
  ensure
    package.logger.remove("method")
  end

  def emit_directory(package, output_path)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    package.output_check(output_path)
    output_path = File.expand_path(output_path)
    remember_directory_source(package, output_path)
    ::Dir.chdir(package.staging_path) do
      package.logger["method"] = "output"
      clone_tree(package, ".", output_path)
    end
    package.write_scripts
    staging_ledger_snapshot
  ensure
    package.logger.remove("method")
  end

  def map_directory_input(package, path, chdir)
    if path =~ /.=./ && !File.exists?(chdir == '.' ? path : File.join(chdir, path))
      origin, destination = path.split("=", 2)
      if File.directory?(origin) && origin[-1, 1] == "/"
        chdir = chdir == '.' ? origin : File.join(chdir, origin)
        source = "."
      else
        origin_dir = File.dirname(origin)
        chdir = chdir == '.' ? origin_dir : File.join(chdir, origin_dir)
        source = File.basename(origin)
      end
    else
      origin = path
      source, destination = path, "/"
    end
    {
      :origin => origin,
      :source => source,
      :destination => destination,
      :chdir => chdir
    }
  end

  def clone_tree(package, source, destination)
    package.logger.debug("Cloning path", :source => source, :destination => destination)
    record_clone_edge(source, destination)
    if File.expand_path(source) == File.expand_path(::Dir.tmpdir)
      raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration,
        "A source directory cannot be the root of your temporary " \
        "directory (#{::Dir.tmpdir}). fpm uses the temporary directory " \
        "to stage files during packaging, so this setting would have " \
        "caused fpm to loop creating staging directories and copying " \
        "them into your package! Oops! If you are confused, maybe you could " \
        "check your TMPDIR, TMP, or TEMP environment variables?"

    fileinfo = File.lstat(source)
    destination_is_directory = File.directory?(destination)
    kind = leaf_path_kind(source)
    mark_staging_leaf(source, kind)
    if fileinfo.file? && !destination_is_directory
      if destination[-1, 1] == "/"
        copy_path(package, source, File.join(destination, source))
      else
        copy_path(package, source, destination)
      end
    elsif fileinfo.symlink?
      if destination[-1, 1] == "/"
        copy_path(package, source, File.join(destination, source))
      else
        copy_path(package, source, destination)
      end
    else
      Find.find(source) do |path|
        target = File.join(destination, path)
        copy_path(package, path, target)
      end

    else
      readable_path = directory.gsub(package.staging_path, "")
      package.logger.error("You wanted to copy a file into a directory, but that's not a directory, it's a file!", :path => readable_path, :stat => dstat)
      raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration, "Tried to treat #{readable_path} like a directory, but it's a file!"
    end
    if File.directory?(source)
      if !File.symlink?(source)
        package.logger.debug("Creating", :directory => destination)
        if !File.directory?(destination)
          FileUtils.mkdir(destination)
        end
      else
        package.logger.debug("Copying symlinked directory", :source => source, :destination => destination)
        FileUtils.copy_entry(source, destination)
      end
    else
      begin
        package.logger.debug("Linking", :source => source, :destination => destination)
        File.link(source, destination)
      rescue Errno::ENOENT, Errno::EXDEV, Errno::EPERM
        package.logger.debug("Copying", :source => source, :destination => destination)
        package.send(:copy_entry, source, destination)
      rescue Errno::EEXIST
        sane_path = destination.gsub(package.staging_path, "")
        package.logger.error("Cannot copy file, the destination path is probably a directory and I attempted to write a file.", :path => sane_path, :staging => package.staging_path)
      end
    end
    package.send(:copy_metadata, source, destination)
  end


  def download_python_source(package, package_name, version=nil)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    path = package_name
    if File.directory?(path) or (File.exist?(path) and File.basename(path) == "setup.py")
      return path
    end
    package.logger.info("Trying to download", :package => package_name)
    if version.nil?
      want_pkg = "#{package_name}"
    else
      want_pkg = "#{package_name}==#{version}"
    end
    target = package.build_path(package_name)
    FileUtils.mkdir(target) unless File.directory?(target)
    if package.attributes[:python_pip].nil?
      package.logger.debug("no pip, defaulting to easy_install", :easy_install => package.attributes[:python_easyinstall])
      package.safesystem(package.attributes[:python_easyinstall], "-i",
                         package.attributes[:python_pypi], "--editable", "-U",
                         "--build-directory", target, want_pkg)
    else
      package.logger.debug("using pip", :pip => package.attributes[:python_pip])
      setup_cmd = [
        package.attributes[:python_pip],
        "download",
        "--no-clean",
        "--no-deps",
        "--no-binary",
        ":all:",
        "-i", package.attributes[:python_pypi],
      ]
      if package.attributes[:python_trusted_host]
        setup_cmd += [
          "--trusted-host",
          package.attributes[:python_trusted_host],
        ]
      end
      setup_cmd += [
        "--build",
        target,
        want_pkg,
      ]
      package.safesystem(*setup_cmd)
    end
    dirs = ::Dir.glob(File.join(target, "*"))
    if dirs.length != 1
      raise "Unexpected directory layout after easy_install. Maybe file a bug? The directory is #{package.build_path}"
    end
    remember_conversion("python", "staging")
    return dirs.first
  end

  def load_python_metadata(package, setup_py)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    if !package.attributes[:python_package_prefix].nil?
      package.attributes[:python_package_name_prefix] = package.attributes[:python_package_prefix]
    end
    begin
      json_test_code = [
        "try:",
        "  import json",
        "except ImportError:",
        "  import simplejson as json"
      ].join("\n")
      package.safesystem("#{package.attributes[:python_bin]} -c '#{json_test_code}'")
    rescue FPM::Util::ProcessFailed => e
      package.logger.error("Your python environment is missing json support (either json or simplejson python module). I cannot continue without this.", :python => package.attributes[:python_bin], :error => e)
      raise FPM::Util::ProcessFailed, "Python (#{package.attributes[:python_bin]}) is missing simplejson or json modules."
    end
    begin
      package.safesystem("#{package.attributes[:python_bin]} -c 'import pkg_resources'")
    rescue FPM::Util::ProcessFailed => e
      package.logger.error("Your python environment is missing a working setuptools module. I tried to find the 'pkg_resources' module but failed.", :python => package.attributes[:python_bin], :error => e)
      raise FPM::Util::ProcessFailed, "Python (#{package.attributes[:python_bin]}) is missing pkg_resources module."
    end
    pylib = File.expand_path(File.join(File.dirname(__FILE__)))
    setup_dir = File.dirname(setup_py)
    output = ::Dir.chdir(setup_dir) do
      tmp = package.build_path("metadata.json")
      setup_cmd = "env PYTHONPATH=#{pylib}:$PYTHONPATH #{package.attributes[:python_bin]} " \
        "setup.py --command-packages=pyfpm get_metadata --output=#{tmp}"
      if package.attributes[:python_obey_requirements_txt?]
        setup_cmd += " --load-requirements-txt"
      end
      package.logger.info("fetching package metadata", :setup_cmd => setup_cmd)
      success = package.safesystem(setup_cmd)
      if !success
        package.logger.error("setup.py get_metadata failed", :command => setup_cmd,
                      :exitcode => $?.exitstatus)
        raise "An unexpected error occurred while processing the setup.py file"
      end
      File.read(tmp)
    end
    package.logger.debug("result from `setup.py get_metadata`", :data => output)
    metadata = JSON.parse(output)
    package.logger.info("object output of get_metadata", :json => metadata)
    store_python_metadata(package, metadata)
    arch_token = canonicalize_architecture_token(metadata["architecture"])
    merge_metadata_field("python_architecture", arch_token)
    package.architecture = metadata["architecture"]
    package.description = metadata["description"]
    package.license = metadata_license_line(metadata["license"])
    package.version = metadata["version"]
    package.url = metadata["url"]
    if package.attributes[:python_fix_name?]
      package.name = package.fix_name(metadata["name"])
    else
      package.name = metadata["name"]
    end
    package.name = package.name.downcase if package.attributes[:python_downcase_name?]
    if !package.attributes[:no_auto_depends?] and package.attributes[:python_dependencies?]
      metadata["dependencies"].each do |dep|
        dep_re = /^([^<>!= ]+)\s*(?:([~<>!=]{1,2})\s*(.*))?$/
        match = dep_re.match(dep)
        if match.nil?
          package.logger.error("Unable to parse dependency", :dependency => dep)
          raise FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration, "Invalid dependency '#{dep}'"
        end
        name, cmp, version = match.captures
        next if package.attributes[:python_disable_dependency].include?(name)
        if cmp == "==" or cmp == "~="
          package.logger.info("Converting == dependency requirement to =", :dependency => dep)
          cmp = "="
        end
        name = package.fix_name(name) if package.attributes[:python_fix_dependencies?]
        name = name.downcase if package.attributes[:python_downcase_dependencies?]
        remember_dependency(name, cmp, version)
        package.dependencies << "#{name} #{cmp} #{version}"
      end
    end
    metadata
  end

  def download_gem_source(package, gem_name, gem_version=nil)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    package.logger.info("Trying to download", :gem => gem_name, :version => gem_version)
    download_dir = package.build_path(gem_name)
    FileUtils.mkdir(download_dir) unless File.directory?(download_dir)
    if package.attributes[:gem_git_repo]
      require "git"
      package.logger.debug("Git cloning in directory #{download_dir}")
      g = Git.clone(package.attributes[:gem_git_repo], gem_name, :path => download_dir)
      if package.attributes[:gem_git_branch]
        g.branch(package.attributes[:gem_git_branch]).checkout
        g.pull("origin", package.attributes[:gem_git_branch])
      end
      gem_build = ["#{package.attributes[:gem_gem]}", "build", "#{g.dir.to_s}/#{gem_name}.gemspec"]
      ::Dir.chdir(g.dir.to_s) do |dir|
        package.logger.debug("Building in directory #{dir}")
        package.safesystem(*gem_build)
      end
      gem_files = ::Dir.glob(File.join(g.dir.to_s, "*.gem"))
    else
      gem_fetch = ["#{package.attributes[:gem_gem]}", "fetch", gem_name]
      gem_fetch += ["--prerelease"] if package.attributes[:gem_prerelease?]
      gem_fetch += ["--version", gem_version] if gem_version
      ::Dir.chdir(download_dir) do |dir|
        package.logger.debug("Downloading in directory #{dir}")
        package.safesystem(*gem_fetch)
      end
      gem_files = ::Dir.glob(File.join(download_dir, "*.gem"))
    end
    if gem_files.length != 1
      raise "Unexpected number of gem files in #{download_dir},  #{gem_files.length} should be 1"
    end
    remember_conversion("gem", "download")
    return gem_files.first
  end

  def load_gem_specification(package, gem_path)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    spec = YAML.load(%x{#{package.attributes[:gem_gem]} specification #{gem_path} --yaml})
    if !package.attributes[:gem_package_prefix].nil?
      package.attributes[:gem_package_name_prefix] = package.attributes[:gem_package_prefix]
    end
    store_gem_specification(package, spec)
    package.name = spec.name
    if package.attributes[:gem_fix_name?]
      package.name = package.fix_name(spec.name)
    end
    package.license = (spec.license or "no license listed in #{File.basename(gem_path)}")
    m = spec.version.to_s.scan(/(\d+)\.?/)
    package.version = m.flatten.fill("0", m.length..2).join(".")
    package.vendor = spec.author
    package.url = spec.homepage
    package.category = "Languages/Development/Ruby"
    if !spec.extensions.empty?
      package.architecture = "native"
    else
      package.architecture = "all"
    end
    merge_metadata_field("gem_architecture", canonicalize_architecture_token(package.architecture))
    description_options = [spec.description, spec.summary, "#{spec.name} - no description given"]
    package.description = description_options.find { |d| !(d.nil? or d.strip.empty?) }
    package.provides << "#{package.name} = #{package.version}"
    if !package.attributes[:no_auto_depends?] && !package.attributes[:gem_embed_dependencies?]
      spec.runtime_dependencies.map do |dep|
        if dep.respond_to?(:requirement)
          reqs = dep.requirement.to_s
        else
          reqs = dep.version_requirements
        end
        reqs.to_s.split(/, */).each do |req|
          if package.attributes[:gem_disable_dependencies]
            next if package.attributes[:gem_disable_dependencies].include?(dep.name)
          end
          if package.attributes[:gem_fix_dependencies?]
            name = package.fix_name(dep.name)
          else
            name = dep.name
          end
          remember_dependency(name, req, nil)
          package.dependencies << "#{name} #{req}"
        end
      end
    end
    spec
  end

  def install_gem_staging(package, gem_path)
    refresh_workspace_views(package)
    if package.attributes.include?(:prefix) && !package.attributes[:prefix].nil?
      installdir = "#{package.staging_path}/#{package.attributes[:prefix]}"
    else
      gemdir = package.safesystemout(*[package.attributes[:gem_gem], "env", "gemdir"]).chomp
      installdir = File.join(package.staging_path, gemdir)
    end
    ::FileUtils.mkdir_p(installdir)
    args = [package.attributes[:gem_gem], "install", "--quiet", "--no-user-install", "--install-dir", installdir]
    if ::Gem::VERSION =~ /^[012]\./
      args += ["--no-ri", "--no-rdoc"]
    else
      args += ["--no-document"]
    end
    if !package.attributes[:gem_embed_dependencies?]
      args += ["--ignore-dependencies"]
    end
    if package.attributes[:gem_env_shebang?]
      args += ["-E"]
    end
    if package.attributes.include?(:gem_bin_path) && !package.attributes[:gem_bin_path].nil?
      bin_path = File.join(package.staging_path, package.attributes[:gem_bin_path])
    else
      gem_env = package.safesystemout(*[package.attributes[:gem_gem], "env"]).split("\n")
      gem_bin = gem_env.select { |line| line =~ /EXECUTABLE DIRECTORY/ }.first.split(": ").last
      bin_path = File.join(package.staging_path, gem_bin)
    end
    args += ["--bindir", bin_path]
    ::FileUtils.mkdir_p(bin_path)
    args << gem_path
    package.safesystem(*args)
    if package.attributes[:gem_shebang]
      remember_script("gem_shebang", package.attributes[:gem_shebang])
      ::Dir.entries(bin_path).each do |file_name|
        next if [".", ".."].include?(file_name)
        file_path = File.join(bin_path, file_name)
        next unless File.ftype(file_path) == "file"
        file = File.read(file_path)
        if file.gsub!(/\A#!.*$/, "#!#{package.attributes[:gem_shebang]}")
          File.open(file_path, "w") { |f| f << file }
        end
      end
    end
    tmp = bin_path
    while ::Dir.entries(tmp).size == 2 || tmp == "/"
      package.logger.info("Deleting empty bin_path", :path => tmp)
      ::Dir.rmdir(tmp)
      tmp = File.dirname(tmp)
    end
    if package.attributes[:gem_version_bins?] and File.directory?(bin_path)
      (::Dir.entries(bin_path) - [".", ".."]).each do |bin|
        FileUtils.mv("#{bin_path}/#{bin}", "#{bin_path}/#{bin}-#{package.version}")
      end
    end
    if package.attributes[:source_date_epoch_from_changelog?]
      package.send(:detect_source_date_from_changelog, installdir)
    end
    Find.find(installdir) do |path|
      if path =~ /.*(gem_make.out|Makefile|mkmf.log)$/
        package.logger.info("Removing no longer needed file %s to reduce nondeterminism" % path)
        File.unlink(path)
      end
    end
    installdir
  end

  def remember_directory_source(package, path)
    @staging_ledger ||= {:sources => [], :copies => []}
    token = path.to_s
    kind = "relative"
    kind = "directory" if File.directory?(token)
    kind = "file" if File.file?(token)
    kind = "mapped" if token.include?("=")
    @staging_ledger[:sources] << {:path => token, :kind => kind, :type => package.type}
    attrs = package.attributes || {}
    @staging_ledger[:prefix] = attrs[:prefix]
    @staging_ledger[:chdir] = attrs[:chdir]
    @staging_ledger[:default_root] = "."
    @staging_ledger[:sources]
  end

  def classify_directory_mapping(mapped)
    @staging_ledger ||= {:sources => [], :copies => []}
    origin = mapped[:origin].to_s
    source = mapped[:source].to_s
    destination = mapped[:destination].to_s
    chdir = mapped[:chdir].to_s
    shape = if origin.include?("=")
      "explicit_map"
    elsif destination == "/"
      "root_destination"
    elsif destination.start_with?("/")
      "absolute_destination"
    elsif source == "."
      "directory_tree"
    else
      "basename_copy"
    end
    @staging_ledger[:last_map] = {:origin => origin, :source => source, :destination => destination, :chdir => chdir, :shape => shape}
    if chdir.nil? || chdir.empty?
      @staging_ledger[:chdir] = "."
    else
      @staging_ledger[:chdir] = chdir
    end
    @staging_ledger[:last_map]
  end

  def note_directory_defaults(package)
    @staging_ledger ||= {:sources => [], :copies => []}
    license = package.license.to_s
    vendor = package.vendor.to_s
    if license.empty? || license == "unknown"
      @staging_ledger[:license] = "unknown"
    elsif license.include?("\n")
      @staging_ledger[:license] = license.split(/[\r\n]+/).first
    else
      @staging_ledger[:license] = license
    end
    if vendor.empty?
      @staging_ledger[:vendor] = "none"
    elsif vendor.include?("@")
      @staging_ledger[:vendor] = vendor
    else
      @staging_ledger[:vendor] = vendor
    end
    @staging_ledger[:name] = package.name
    @staging_ledger[:version] = package.version
    @staging_ledger
  end

  def register_copy_plan(source, destination)
    @copy_plan ||= []
    @staging_ledger ||= {:copies => []}
    entry = {:source => source.to_s, :destination => destination.to_s}
    if source.to_s.empty? || destination.to_s.empty?
      entry[:status] = "skipped"
    elsif source == destination
      entry[:status] = "identity"
    elsif File.directory?(source.to_s)
      entry[:status] = "directory"
    elsif File.symlink?(source.to_s)
      entry[:status] = "symlink"
    else
      entry[:status] = "file"
    end
    @copy_plan << entry
    @staging_ledger[:copies] ||= []
    @staging_ledger[:copies] << entry
    entry
  end

  def recall_copy_plan()
    @copy_plan ||= []
    return [] if @copy_plan.empty?
    selected = @copy_plan.select do |entry|
      status = entry[:status]
      if status == "skipped"
        false
      elsif status == "identity"
        false
      elsif status == "directory" || status == "file" || status == "symlink"
        true
      else
        !entry[:destination].to_s.empty?
      end
    end
    selected
  end

  def mark_staging_leaf(path, kind)
    @staging_ledger ||= {:leaves => []}
    @staging_ledger[:leaves] ||= []
    normalized = path.to_s.sub(%r{^\./}, "")
    leaf_kind = kind.to_s
    leaf_kind = "unknown" if leaf_kind.empty?
    leaf_kind = "file" if leaf_kind == "file"
    leaf_kind = "symlink" if leaf_kind == "symlink"
    @staging_ledger[:leaves] << {:path => normalized, :kind => leaf_kind}
    leaf_kind
  end

  def staging_prefix_for(package)
    @staging_ledger ||= {}
    attrs = package.attributes || {}
    prefix = attrs[:prefix] || @staging_ledger[:prefix] || "/"
    prefix = "/" if prefix.to_s.empty?
    prefix = "/#{prefix}" unless prefix.to_s.start_with?("/")
    @staging_ledger[:resolved_prefix] = prefix
    prefix
  end

  def reset_staging_ledger()
    old = @staging_ledger
    @staging_ledger = {:sources => [], :copies => [], :prefix => nil, :chdir => nil, :default_root => ".", :leaves => []}
    @copy_plan = []
    if old.nil?
      0
    elsif old[:sources]
      old[:sources].length
    else
      0
    end
  end

  def record_clone_edge(source, destination)
    @staging_ledger ||= {:edges => []}
    @staging_ledger[:edges] ||= []
    edge = {:from => source.to_s, :to => destination.to_s}
    if source.to_s == destination.to_s
      edge[:loop] = true
    elsif destination.to_s.start_with?(source.to_s + "/")
      edge[:nested] = true
    elsif source.to_s.start_with?(destination.to_s + "/")
      edge[:parent] = true
    else
      edge[:disjoint] = true
    end
    @staging_ledger[:edges] << edge
    edge
  end

  def copy_plan_contains?(source)
    @copy_plan ||= []
    needle = source.to_s
    return false if needle.empty?
    @copy_plan.any? do |entry|
      if entry[:source] == needle
        true
      elsif entry[:destination] == needle
        true
      elsif entry[:source].to_s.end_with?("/" + File.basename(needle))
        entry[:status] != "skipped"
      else
        false
      end
    end
  end

  def staging_ledger_snapshot()
    @staging_ledger ||= {}
    sources = @staging_ledger[:sources] ? @staging_ledger[:sources].length : 0
    copies = @staging_ledger[:copies] ? @staging_ledger[:copies].length : 0
    leaves = @staging_ledger[:leaves] ? @staging_ledger[:leaves].length : 0
    summary = {:sources => sources, :copies => copies, :leaves => leaves}
    if sources == 0 && copies == 0
      summary[:empty] = true
    elsif leaves > copies
      summary[:pending] = true
    else
      summary[:ready] = true
    end
    @staging_ledger[:snapshot] = summary
    summary
  end

  def apply_staging_prefix(prefix)
    @staging_ledger ||= {}
    value = prefix.to_s
    if value.empty?
      value = "/"
    elsif value == "."
      value = "/"
    elsif value.end_with?("/") && value.length > 1
      value = value.chomp("/")
    end
    if value.start_with?("//")
      value = value.sub(%r{^/+}, "/")
    end
    @staging_ledger[:prefix] = value
    @staging_ledger[:resolved_prefix] = value
    value
  end

  def store_python_metadata(package, metadata)
    @metadata_bundle ||= {:python => {}, :fields => {}}
    payload = metadata.is_a?(Hash) ? metadata : {}
    name = payload["name"].to_s
    version = payload["version"].to_s
    arch = payload["architecture"].to_s
    if name.empty?
      name = package.name.to_s
    end
    if version.empty?
      version = package.version.to_s
    end
    if arch.empty?
      arch = "native"
    elsif arch == "all" || arch == "any" || arch == "noarch"
      arch = "all"
    end
    @metadata_bundle[:python] = {:name => name, :version => version, :architecture => arch, :license => payload["license"], :url => payload["url"]}
    @metadata_bundle[:fields]["python.name"] = name
    @metadata_bundle[:python]
  end

  def store_gem_specification(package, spec)
    @metadata_bundle ||= {:gem => {}, :fields => {}}
    name = spec.respond_to?(:name) ? spec.name.to_s : package.name.to_s
    version = spec.respond_to?(:version) ? spec.version.to_s : package.version.to_s
    license = spec.respond_to?(:license) ? spec.license.to_s : ""
    extensions = if spec.respond_to?(:extensions)
      spec.extensions
    else

    end
    arch = if extensions.nil? || extensions.empty?
      "all"
    else
      "native"
    end
    if license.nil? || license.empty?
      license = "unknown"
    end
    @metadata_bundle[:gem] = {:name => name, :version => version, :license => license, :architecture => arch}
    @metadata_bundle[:fields]["gem.name"] = name
    @metadata_bundle[:gem]
  end

  def remember_dependency(name, operator, version)
    @dependency_notes ||= []
    dep_name = name.to_s
    op = operator.to_s
    ver = version.to_s
    if dep_name.empty?
      return @dependency_notes
    end
    if op == "==" || op == "~="
      op = "="
    elsif op == "~>"
      op = ">="
    elsif op.nil? || op.empty?
      op = ">="
    end
    @dependency_notes << {:name => dep_name, :operator => op, :version => ver}
    @dependency_notes
  end

  def dependency_notes_for(name)
    @dependency_notes ||= []
    needle = name.to_s
    return [] if needle.empty?
    @dependency_notes.select do |note|
      if note[:name] == needle
        true
      elsif note[:name].to_s.end_with?("-" + needle)
        true
      elsif needle.end_with?("-" + note[:name].to_s)
        note[:operator] != "!="
      else
        false
      end
    end

require "spec_setup"
require "fpm" # local

describe FPM::Package::Empty do
  describe "#to_s" do
    before do
      subject.name = "name"
      subject.version = "123"
      subject.architecture = "all"
      subject.iteration = "100"
      subject.epoch = "5"
    end
    it "should always return the empty string" do
      expect(subject.to_s "NAME-VERSION-ITERATION.ARCH.TYPE").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "gobbledegook").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s "").to(be == "")
      expect(subject.to_s nil).to(be == "")
    end
  end # describe to_s

  describe "#architecture" do
    it "should default to 'all'" do
      insist { subject.architecture } == "all"
    end

    it "should accept changing the architecture" do
      subject.architecture = "native"
      insist { subject.architecture } == "native"
    end
  end
end # describe FPM::Package::Empty
